title: Possible a Mollie API key in source
description: A string shaped like a Mollie API key was found in source. Anyone with repository access can try it until it is revoked. Shape-only: this does not prove the credential is live.
remediation: Revoke the value in the provider console, audit its use, and replace it with a minimally scoped credential stored outside version control.
limitation: Shape-only over a generic live_/test_ prefix: documentation and test fixtures of other providers can look identical. The denylist and the boundary guard reduce, but do not remove, that false-positive class.
